# `/launchers` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /launchers/v1

`getLaunchersV1` — List all launchers for tenant

Return a list of Launchers for the authenticated tenant

- Scopes: sp:launcher-admin:read, sp:launcher-user:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: description: sw; disabled: eq; name: sw — e.g. `disabled eq "true"`
  - `next` (query) — Pagination marker
  - `limit` (query) — max 100 — default 10 — Number of Launchers to return
- Returns 200: object

### POST /launchers/v1

`createLauncherV1` — Create launcher

Create a Launcher with given information

- Scopes: sp:launcher-admin:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): launcherrequest
- Returns 201: launcher

### GET /launchers/v1/{launcherID}

`getLauncherV1` — Get launcher by id

Get details for the given Launcher ID

- Scopes: sp:launcher-admin:read, sp:launcher-user:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `launcherID` (path, required) — ID of the Launcher to be retrieved
- Returns 200: launcher

### PUT /launchers/v1/{launcherID}

`putLauncherV1` — Replace launcher

Replace the given Launcher ID with given payload

- Scopes: sp:launcher-admin:write
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `launcherID` (path, required) — ID of the Launcher to be replaced
- Body (application/json): launcherrequest
- Returns 200: launcher

### DELETE /launchers/v1/{launcherID}

`deleteLauncherV1` — Delete launcher

Delete the given Launcher ID

- Scopes: sp:launcher-admin:delete
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `launcherID` (path, required) — ID of the Launcher to be deleted
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /launchers/v1/{launcherID}/launch

`startLauncherV1` — Launch a launcher

Launch the given Launcher ID

- Scopes: sp:launcher-user:launch
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `launcherID` (path, required) — ID of the Launcher to be launched
- Returns 200: object
